q: How many units of Mouse do we have in stock?
gold_sql: SELECT s.qty FROM stock s JOIN products p ON p.id = s.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Mouse'

q: Which products are below their reorder level?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN stock s ON s.product_id = p.id WHERE s.qty < p.reorder_level ORDER BY p.name

q: What was our total revenue in March 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) FROM sales WHERE date LIKE '2026-03%'

q: Which 3 products earned the most revenue overall?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN sales s ON s.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY SUM(s.revenue) DESC LIMIT 3

q: How many products are in each category?
gold_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

q: Which supplier has the longest lead time?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM suppliers ORDER BY lead_days DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many units did we sell in the Grocery category in total?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(s.qty) FROM sales s JOIN products p ON p.id = s.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Grocery'

q: Which products have fewer than 15 units in stock?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN stock s ON s.product_id = p.id WHERE s.qty < 15 ORDER BY p.name

q: What is the total quantity of Notebook sold?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(s.qty) FROM sales s JOIN products p ON p.id = s.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Notebook'

q: Which category earned the most revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT p.category FROM products p JOIN sales s ON s.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(s.revenue) DESC LIMIT 1

q: List all products supplied by Beta Wholesale.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN suppliers s ON s.id = p.supplier_id WHERE s.name = 'Beta Wholesale' ORDER BY p.name

q: What is the unit cost of Olive Oil?
gold_sql: SELECT unit_cost FROM products WHERE name = 'Olive Oil'
